usedFor: TickTick holds tasks, and Slack gets a message when “New Task Created” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in TickTick, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: New tasks reach a Slack channel, and the trigger can filter by list, tag or priority to cut noise.

watchOut: “New Task Created” in TickTick is polling, and a Slack channel post waits for approval today.
